name: Trainwreck: Storm Area 51
summary: A viral joke about storming a secretive US Air Force base sparks a meme-fueled media frenzy and puts the military on alert in this bizarre true story.

previousepisode.name: They Can't Stop All of Us

name: Secret Life of the Auction House
summary:
Featuring exclusive access, riveting stories, surprising revelations, and jaw-dropping hammer prices, Secret Life of the Auction House goes behind the scenes at one of Britain's busiest auction houses to capture all the drama, passion, and charisma as antiques specialist Charles Hanson and a small army of experts examine, appraise, strategize, and sell to the highest bidder—all while making historic discoveries and keeping an eye out for fakes.

Every treasure has a unique story to tell. And with hundreds of thousands of objects coming through the door every year, Charles and the team bring long-forgotten relics, cherished heirlooms, attic discoveries, and metal detector finds to life

previousepisode.name: Casino Royale, Sweet Shop, Shrovetide Ball

name: Знахарь
summary: Kostya, the ambulance driver, is used to living one day at a time. Mired in debt and loans, he couldn't think of anything better than to take the first bus he saw and get away from Moscow and his problems. So he finds himself in a southern village, where he is mistaken for the long-awaited doctor Christopher Sergeevich. The locals welcome Kostya with all cordiality and even provide him with housing. It seems that the guy had the perfect chance to quickly resolve the issue of money and return to Moscow. But pretending to be an experienced healer without understanding anything about medicine is not an easy task, so Kostya will have to somehow get out of it.

name: Meet You and Turn Bad Luck Into Good
The Hidden Heir Ye Chen
summary: The so-called useless live-in son-in-law is actually the eldest grandson of a billionaire family. To survive, he hides his identity and marries into another household as a nobody. But beneath that humble facade, he sweeps through high society, building power while hunting the mastermind behind his parents' murder. Along the way, Ye Chen gathers loyal allies and forms deep bonds with trusted confidantes. As the truth about his parents' deaths comes to light, a new identity crisis emerges, threatening everything he's fought for. With danger closing in from all sides, how will Ye Chen fight back this time?

name: The Killer Next Door
summary: A bromance story between Yun Je, a timid part-timer who is afraid of guns and swords and kills people in outrageous ways, and Jin Hyeok, a former superstar baseball player who has been saving Yun Je's targets for some time.

name: Mr. & Mrs. Murder
summary: Four close friends' seemingly perfect lives unravel after one vanishes on a hunting trip. Nearly 20 years later, the truth emerges with devastating consequences.

name: Perf
summary: Perf is an ensemble multi-camera comedy that reflects Andrea Savage's aspirational, edgy real life-based voice and her ability to tap into the humor of being an adult.

name: Pitch Perfect: K-Pop Idols
summary: Pitch Perfect: K-Pop Idols follows a struggling singer-songwriter whose life completely turns upside down when she finds herself auditioning to be a part of the first all-American K-pop group.

name: Rays of Sunshine
summary: Yeon Woo grew up happy in a loving family. One day, her father had died mysteriously, and her mother remarried a man who was 10 years younger than her. Misfortunes never come singly. Her mother died of Wilson's disease and her step-father ran away with money. Min Ho, an old friend of hers, is always there to comforther. Min Ho decided to be a policeman to catch a murderer who killed Yeon Woo's father. Eun Sup came back to Korea with the sole purpose of stopping his lover Soo Ah from getting married, but Soo Ah gave him an outright denial. To make matter wose, his father sent people over to his hotel to catch him. He ran away from the hotel and he accidentally fell into the subway track and became unconscious. Yeon Woo saw the whole scene in the platform and saved his life. Eun Sup asked her if he could stay in her place temporarily since he had no place to go. So Yeon Woo, Min Ho and Eun Sup all started living in a same house.

name: Code Geass: Soubou no Oz Picture Drama
summary:
Code Geass: Soubou no Oz Picture Drama following the lives of two characters from opposite sides of the barricades: Orpheus Zevon—young theorist from KMF searching for the killer of his mistress and Oldrin Zevon—protiteristické member unit of the British Empire "Glindyni knights." Drama quite obviously inspired by the classic story of The Wizard of Oz.

This is OVA series.

name: KRAYS: London's Gangsters
summary: Reggie and Ronnie Kray built a feared yet admired criminal empire in East London. Never-before-heard tapes reveal their bond, ambition, and downfall.

name: Military Machines: Nazi Germany in WWII
summary: This is the story of the creation of the Nazi War Machine, tracing their origins from street thugs battling in the German streets after The Great War. We show the growth of the Panzer Corps, the mighty Luftwaffe and the feared SS. This is the most comprehensive look at the military force that took Europe by a storm of blood and steel.

name: My Troublesome Star
summary: A drama about a young top actress named Im Se Ra, who gets into an accident on the day she is to receive her Best Actress award, and comes back to work after a 25-year career gap.

name: Menem Junior, la Muerte del Hijo del Presidente
summary: A four-part docuseries investigating the 1995 death of Argentine president Carlos Menem's son -- and a mother's decades-long quest for justice.

name: Built in Birmingham: Brady & the Blues
summary: The five-part docuseries tells the authentic tale of a club accustomed to sporting heartbreak, who are rebuilt to win, with American football legend Tom Brady laying out their new mission statement: "We're trying to make this a world-class team." Built in Birmingham: Brady & the Blues follows that journey, as a new ownership group suffer relegation and multiple managerial changes en route to a record-breaking season, which delivered automatic promotion to the EFL Sky Bet Championship.

name: Griff's Great American South
summary: From Nashville to New Orleans, comedian Griff Rhys Jones goes on an epic road trip across the US Deep South, exploring America's secret heart and busting the clichés with his trademark wit and warmth.

name: Seven Wonders of the Ancient World with Bettany Hughes
summary:
Their names still echo down the ages: The Great Pyramid at Giza. The Hanging Gardens of Babylon. The Temple of Artemis. The statue of Zeus at Olympia. The mausoleum of Halikarnassos. The Colossus at Rhodes. The Lighthouse of Alexandria. The Seven Wonders of the World were staggeringly audacious impositions on our planet. They were also brilliant adventures of the mind, test cases for the reaches of human imagination. Now only the great pyramid remains fully standing, yet the scale and majesty of these seven wonders still enthral us today.

In a thrilling, colourful narrative enriched with the latest archaeological discoveries, historian Bettany Hughes walks through the landscapes of both ancient and modern time. This is a journey whose purpose is to ask why we wonder, why we create, why we choose to remember the wonder of others. She explores traces of the Wonders themselves, and the traces they have left in history. A magisterial work of historical storytelling, The Seven Wonders of the Ancient World reinforces the exciting and nourishing notion that humans can make the impossible happen.

previousepisode.name: The Mausoleum of Halicarnassus, Hanging Gardens of Babylon and Temple of Artemi

name: Bride Swap
summary: In her past life, Xie Minglan was bestowed the title of a first-rank noble lady, basking in glory and prestige. Meanwhile, her sister Xie Molan became a young widow, confined to a lonely Buddhist retreat. Consumed by jealousy, Xie Molan killed Xie Minglan, only to find herself reborn with her sister on the day when they were both to be wed. This time, Xie Molan desperately schemes to marry Mr. Pei, the down-and-out heir, believing this will swap their fates. Little does she know that she has chosen a path of no return.

name: Saka Bi' Yana
summary: Stand-up artists, who make people laugh by telling sections from life, reveal the realities of their own lives in this documentary.

name: 21 Days Sunshine
summary: A chaotic story begins when neat third-year Sun has to welcome his first-year junior Shine into his home.

name: Hotel Sofia
summary: Hotel Sofia is about an ex-pat who runs a hotel full of American foreign exchange students in Greece.

name: The Proof Is Out There: Unexplained Edition
summary: In this special edition series of The Proof Is Out There, journalist Tony Harris explores some of the most astonishing phenomena ever captured on camera. From UFOs and cryptids to eerie encounters and unexplained forces, Tony and a team of experts analyze the evidence and deliver their verdict.

name: Gong Lve Jiang Jun Ji Hua
Tai Hao Le Shi Fu Bao, Wo Men You Jiu Le
Mike Brewer: Born Dealer
summary: Motor trader Mike Brewer has been buying and selling cars on our TV screens for 27 years. But now he's facing real world challenges; a brand-new car dealership and the restoration of an old manor house. Has he bitten off more than he can chew?

name: Mitchell & Webb Are Not Helping
summary: David Mitchell and Robert Webb are returning to Channel 4 with a brand-new sketch show, which sees them combine forces with a host of exciting and innovative future stars, marking a bold return to British sketch comedy with an innovative merging of comedy minds across generations.

name: Georgia and Tommy: Happy Essex After
summary: Follow TOWIE couple Tommy Mallet and Georgia Kousoulou as they welcome a new child into their world and finally get married in a beautiful Mallorca ceremony.

name: Capturing Their Killer: The Girls on the High Bridge
summary:
In the bucolic town of Delphi, Indiana, 13-year-old Abigail Williams and 14-year-old Liberty German set out for a walk on a warm February afternoon in 2017 — and never came home. Their bodies were discovered the next day in a wooded area not far from the trail, setting off a five-year-long search that gripped the nation and haunted this close-knit community. But what set this case apart wasn't just the shocking brutality of the crime, but also the chilling piece of evidence found on Libby's phone.

The three-part series Capturing Their Killer: The Girls on the High Bridge is a wide-lensed view of the case that captured headlines and unraveled this tight-knit community, revisiting their trauma as the anxious public waited years for a break in the case. The series also explores the arrest of Richard Allen, a local man accused and convicted of the vicious murders in 2024. The case includes stunning claims, theories and bizarre evidence that set social media ablaze with ruled out alternative hypotheses and other possible suspects. The series features an exclusive interview with Kathy Allen, wife of Richard Allen, who shares her story and personal photos from her relationship with the convicted murderer; exclusive interviews with John Galipeau, the former Warden at Westville Correctional Facility, where Richard Allen was held; friends and family members of the victims; newly released interrogation footage and prison calls between Richard and Kathy; and exclusive behind-the-scenes footage of the defense's trial prep.

name: Stalking Samantha: 13 Years of Terror
summary:
When Samantha Stites — a bright, outgoing college freshman — met Christopher Thomas in 2011, an unsettling obsession took hold. For the next 11-year period, Christopher constantly stalked Samantha, sometimes stealthily and sometimes openly, showing up consistently where she went — restaurants, grocery stores, sporting events and more — until an early fall morning in 2022, when the harassment turned into something unimaginably dangerous. Christopher broke into her home, kidnapped and restrained her, and transported her to a soundproof bunker he had constructed in a storage unit near her Michigan home. Cut off from the outside world and completely alone, Samantha had to summon every ounce of strength to survive and escape.

In this gripping three-part docuseries, Samantha shares her story publicly for the first time, recounting more than a decade of fear, resistance and resilience. Featuring never-before-seen police interview footage, surveillance from the storage unit, and disturbing images and videos recovered from Christopher's phone, the series also includes powerful testimony from Samantha's friends and the investigators who helped bring her stalker to justice.

name: Say You Love Me
summary:
Say You Love Me (사랑한다 말해줘) is a poignant drama that delves into the fragile beauty of youthful love and the painful weight of adult regrets. Kim Byung-soo and Seo Young-chae have grown up together, bound by shared dreams and a quiet, enduring affection. As they step into the world of filmmaking, their bond begins to blossom into something deeper—an innocent, wholehearted romance that offers them both a sense of belonging.

But their world is disrupted when they enter the orbit of Cho In-ah, a powerful and ambitious film company executive who once chose career over love. Haunted by the emotional void in her life, In-ah finds herself drawn to Byung-soo's sincerity and resents the warmth she sees between him and Young-chae. Driven by a mix of desire and jealousy, she becomes determined to fracture their love—enlisting her partner Park Hee-soo in a quiet campaign to intervene.

As emotions clash and intentions blur, *Say You Love Me* becomes a layered exploration of love in its many forms—innocent, manipulative, desperate, and sacrificial. With emotionally resonant performances and a melancholic undercurrent, the drama asks whether love can truly survive ambition, insecurity, and betrayal—or whether saying "I love you" is sometimes not enough.

name: Learning to Love
summary: When a cautious teacher agrees to tutor a nightlife host who struggles to read and write, their growing connection sparks criticism and controversy.

name: Islanders
summary: Li Xianhong, a charismatic entrepreneur, is entangled in a web of complicated relationships with his business partner, Xiaowen, his assistant, Hanrong, and a young woman, Lilian. Lilian reconnects with her senior Jay, and jealousy brews. When Xianhong's offhand remarks spark a public backlash, social media erupts, and Xianhong faces the decision that could cost him everything he holds dear.

name: My Youth
summary: Sunwoo Hae was a popular child actor, who shined in his youth. Due to the greed of the adults around him, he lost his shining light. He barely made it through the turmoil and now lives peacefully as a novelist and florist. Suddenly, Seong Je Yeon appears in front of him. Sunwoo Hae and Seong Je Yeon were each other's first love and they helped each other get through the darkest times of their lives. They reunite after 10 years. The appearance of Je Yeon also reminds him of his past. Meanwhile, Je Yeon works as a team leader for Feel Entertainment. She grew up in a wealthy family, without any worries, but her family suddenly fell into ruin. She now lives more fiercely than anyone else around her. She is driven by reality and only looks for success in her life. To achieve her goal, she finds Sunwoo Hae, who was her first love, and breaks his peace. As she gets involved with him, she also experiences change by confronting her innocent past self.

name: French Gourmet with Justine Schofield
summary: Embark on a culinary adventure through Southern France with renowned cook Justine Scholfield in 'French Gourmet.' Viewers are immersed in the rich aromas of French cuisine as Justine explores the canals of Burgundy on a magical barge journey. From historical towns to encounters with artisanal producers, 'French Gourmet' captures the essence of local markets and the delectable offerings of charming restaurants. Join Justine in celebrating the timeless allure of French cuisine and experience the magic of Southern France.

name: Our Golden Days
summary: A story about finding the true meaning of family through the process of the older generation, and their children understanding each other's pain.

name: El regreso de la Heredera Fugitiva
summary: Reina is a determined young woman who returns to the ranch she inherited from her father to confront the deep-rooted machismo in the community and fight to earn the respect of the workers, while defending her family legacy.

name: Te escribí antes de conocerte
summary: He stole her diary to become famous… and ended up writing his own love story.

name: Intensamente Victoria
summary: Victoria can hear what the men are thinking; they all want her, but all she can think about is Polo, who's in a relationship with her best friend. Although they try to avoid it, an intense and secret love affair between them complicates everything.

name: Me fui gata volví perra
summary: Matilda is a young woman, invisible to everyone, who works as a cleaner at a publishing house, where she is mistreated by her colleagues. After being unfairly fired, she returns as the owner and boss to take revenge on those who made her hate her job.

name: ¡Mamá, no me dejes morir!
summary: After being widowed and destitute, a young woman will be forced to make a pact with her ruthless and wealthy mother-in-law to save the life of her young son.

name: Destinada a ser la dueña
summary: 'Diablera' is a young fighter who works delivering merchandise to and from a market where she demonstrates natural leadership and where she will find the love of her life in the son of a wealthy businessman amidst shady interests.

name: The Holiday
summary: The Holiday centers on two women, one British and one American, who swap houses during the Christmas season and find love along the way.

name: Mei Guan Xi Shi Jia Ren A
Zhe Hou Fu Fu Ren Wo Bu Dang Le
Fell Upon Me
summary: In 2012, just before the college entrance examination, transfer student Jiang Ling suddenly enters An Zhenzhen's world when his phone accidentally connects to "Old Jiang" from 2024. Guided by "Old Jiang," An Zhenzhen approaches the young Jiang Ling, attempting to alter the future, but trigger a misunderstanding with her best friend, Qiu Qian. This seemingly bizarre encounter entwines Jiang Ling's and An Zhenzhen's fates. While uncovering the truth behind the looming crisis together, An Zhenzhen is hit by the public exposure of her family troubles and false accusations that leave her abandoned by those around her. In despair, she climbs to the rooftop, but is saved by Jiang Ling. With his help, she mends her friendship, but a new crisis quietly emerges. To stop her class president, Gu Ming, who is acting under coercion, An Zhenzhen once again steps onto the rooftop. In another timeline, "Old Jiang" painfully searches for the truth and tries to change events—but cannot prevent An Zhenzhen's death. Just as the story reaches the brink of despair, pages turn and gears softly click. Under the power of words, the cold "doomsday" prophecy is quietly rewritten.

name: Babar and the Adventures of Badou
summary: The series follows the adventures of Babar's 8-year-old grandson Badou, who along with his friends and family, solves numerous mysteries, puzzles and situations in Celesteville. The city now features other animals besides elephants.

name: Zero Day Attack
summary: A candidate from the pro-war faction wins the presidential election, leading to an agitated situation in the Taiwan Strait. An unexpected incident occurs when a Yun-8 reconnaissance aircraft crosses the South China Sea and crashes into the Pacific Ocean off the east coast of Taiwan. Under the pretext of search and rescue, the Chinese side mobilized many naval and air forces. On the Zero Day of the PLA's central landing, as unrest within Taiwan escalates, the situation enters its final countdown.

name: Po jedné stopě
summary: In this road series, two friends set off on motorbikes through the coastal countries of Africa from Morocco towards South Africa. The journey to Iraq was a kind of test of whether Martin Písařík could handle his first journey on a motorbike beyond the borders of the Czech Republic. The beginner is tested on the route from Turkey to Iraq by experienced and respected traveller Igor Brezovar. Then a long ride to Africa awaited them both... Igor, a Slovenian, has been living in the Czech Republic for years, he is a person who is friendly towards all the people he meets. And so, thanks to his immediacy, both travellers get to the homes of local residents, where they can see into their family life, as well as exceptional events, celebrations or tribal rituals. Actor Martin Písařík is also an adventurer at heart, but a novice motorcyclist, who bravely copes with the often difficult terrain or the vagaries of the motorbike.

name: All the Sinners Bleed
summary: Haunted by his devout mother's untimely death, the first Black Sheriff in a small Bible Belt county must lead the hunt for a serial killer that has been preying on his Black community for years in the name of God.

name: Murder 360
summary: Murder 360 is a true crime docuseries that uncovers ten gripping murder cases from every possible angle. Through intimate interviews, expert analysis, and rare footage, the series paints a vivid portrait of the motive, method, and aftermath of each crime - from thrill killings to deadly vows.

name: Reborn in the 90s: Remarry and Walk the Path of Blossoms
Substitute for Love
summary: Zhong Zimo is shocked to discover that Chu Ruoyun, who closely resembles his late lover Li Yinuo, is actually Long Haotian's wife. Believing their marriage is a loveless contract, he joins forces with Li Yiran, the adopted daughter of Li Xiaohan, to bring down the Long Corporation. After being rejected by Long Haotian, Li Yiran sows discord between him and Chu Ruoyun, leading to deeper misunderstandings. Pressured by his family, Long Haotian drives the pregnant Chu Ruoyun away; she later suffers a miscarriage and is kidnapped. Zhong Zimo and Long Haotian rescue her, and Long Haotian chooses to leave his family to stay by her side. Zhong Zimo then reveals a shocking truth: Chu Ruoyun is Li Yinuo's long-lost twin, the biological daughter of the Li family, secretly switched at birth. Reunited with her true family, Chu Ruoyun overcomes all obstacles with Long Haotian, and the lingering obsessions of Zhong Zimo and Li Yiran finally come to an end.

name: Dictator: The Hitler Interviews
summary: With populist leaders thriving and dictatorships on the rise, this series looks at Hitler from a different perspective - through his friends, enablers and associates. For the first time on television, these recorded testimonies are brought together to create a unique portrait of Hitler. Many of those featured are Nazis. Few can be trusted. But if we see Hitler through their eyes, it's possible to grasp who Hitler was and what made him possible.

name: Let the Devil In
summary: Let the Devil In is a haunting and mysterious four-episode documentary series about a decades-old tragedy that destroyed one family and ignited the darkest fears of a small New Jersey town. For the first time, witnesses, friends, and community members try to make sense of the unthinkable events, some believing that Satan took hold of a vulnerable teen boy, while others believe that far more earthly demons were to blame.

name: Woof!
summary: Award-winning children's adventures featuring a young schoolboy who is like any other youngster - except for the fact that he keeps turning into a dog!

name: The Chrisleys: Back to Reality
summary:
The series begins during the wake of the family's controversy and upheaval with Todd and Julie in federal prison and follows the family as their parents are eventually pardoned, released from prison and return home. The series shows a side of the Chrisleys that has never been seen before with exclusive access to the family—Julie and Todd from prison and upon their release, Savannah, Chase, Grayson, Chloe, Nanny Faye, and for the first time, Julie's parents Harvey and Pam. 

The new series exposes the raw truth of the Chrisley's lives—past and present—and the reality is far different from what audiences have seen before. The family faces a critical point that will either make their bond stronger or leave it shattered forever. This series delivers an unfiltered, deeply personal look at their journey and introduces the real Chrisleys as they navigate this new chapter.

name: Killer Class
summary: Killer Class tracks the unexpected formation of a HS Forensics Club that proves shockingly effective at solving real cold cases.

name: Povratak Otpisanih
summary: Povratak Otpisanih is the direct sequel to Otpisani, continuing the story of the same resistance fighters, primarily Prle and Tihi, as they take on new missions in occupied Belgrade. While maintaining the tone and style of the original, the sequel introduces more complex plots and deeper character dynamics, further developing the narrative established in the first series.

name: Shaun the Sheep Mossy Bottom Mayhem
summary: A new take on life at the farm featuring mayhem-filled moments from Shaun and the other animals.

name: Mørch og makta
summary: Is Støre jealous of Stoltenberg? How good is Listhaug at English? Does Vedum have an alibi for September 11? Video podcast with Erlend Mørch and the political leaders.

name: Music Story: Losing Control
summary: A relationship that starts with loneliness, money and deception—how will it conclude? The outcome lies in the hands of Queen, Bam and Sea.

name: La Hija de Dios: Dalma Maradona
summary: Dalma Maradona travels to the places she shared with her father and tries to understand how she came to be called "the daughter of God."

name: Piggy Builders
summary: Piggy Builders follows Cornelia, Cesar and Charlie, three curly-tailed piggy siblings who love building and solving problems in their community – and, most importantly, they love each other!

name: The Return of the Queen
summary: Xu Haimeng, heiress to the Yunhai Group, enters into a political marriage with the eldest son of the newly wealthy Lu family. Shortly after their wedding, the couple travels abroad for their honeymoon only to tragically drown in an unexpected accident. On the very day the Lu family holds a shareholders' meeting to seize control of Yunhai Group, Xu Haimeng suddenly returns. Not only has she risen from the ashes, but she stages a dramatic comeback, taking back Yunhai with overwhelming force. This leads to a complete falling-out with the Lu family. Lu Siyu, the younger son, becomes her fiercest rival, suspicious of her true identity and determined to uncover the truth behind his brother's death. As the two clash repeatedly, caught in a web of secrets and danger, Lu Siyu finally uncovers the truth about the "deadly honeymoon": Xu Haimeng had been pushed off a cliff by his brother and barely survived after a harrowing struggle between life and death. Everyone believed Xu Haimeng had returned to avenge her husband, but in reality, she came back to expose the true mastermind who ordered her murder. The shocking twist changes Lu Siyu's view of her, and the two go from enemies to reluctant allies, gradually growing closer. But just when things seem to settle, a new blow strikes. Lu Siyu turns out to be the legal beneficiary of Yunhai Group after the attempted murder. Devastated, Xu Haimeng cuts ties with him completely, and in doing so, uncovers a massive, long-buried scandal within the Lu family. Through unwavering resilience, she secures Yunhai's future. Lu Siyu, finally letting go of the betrayal from his family, comes to terms with his pain. Supporting each other through the storm, they rebuild the Yunhai Group and step forward onto a brand-new path in life together.

name: Hidden Love
summary: In the early Republican era, Shu Yan, a street performer, is knocked unconscious and kidnapped. When she wakes up, she is shocked to find herself transformed into the wife of Yan Qizhao, the influential president of a prominent trade association. An esteemed husband, endless gold and silver adornments, obedient servants—every piece of evidence confirms her identity as the president's wife. Yet, Shu Yan grows increasingly certain that something is shrouded in mystery. Yan Qizhao's tender care gradually draws her in, but soon, she discovers it is all part of a deadly trap he had meticulously set from the very beginning.

name: Осторожно, люди!
summary: The teacher of the Semyonov Faculty of Philology, the most spineless being on the planet, is possessed by an alien whose ship has crashed. To his horror, the alien learns that humanity is burning oil, which was created by scientists of their more advanced civilization as a cure for all diseases. He wants to warn the "tribesmen" so that together they can clear the Land of "pest people." But to do this, you need to repair the ship in a quiet place. However, he is not allowed to retire by Semenov's daughter Alyona, his ex-wife Katya, the dean, the commandant, a ufologist, and a strong passion for his colleague Anna Mikhailovna.

name: Свадьба по-русски! с америкашкой Дэни
summary: A wedding reality show in which Russian-American actor Daniel Barnes, known as American Dani, will watch and comment on the celebrations. He is well acquainted with American canons, and now he will immerse himself in Russian traditions. The host will evaluate the outfits of the bride and groom, the decoration of the hall, the music, the dishes and the general atmosphere. He will also dispel stereotypes, play games from the toastmaster and learn holiday terminology.

name: Pets Win Prizes
summary:
A game show in which hens compete to see which one can keep from clucking the longest? And in which goldfish play croquet and hamsters take part in a Grand Prix? It sounds unbelievable but this series promises just that.

In each programme's five rounds animals of the same species strive to win prizes for their owners in games such as That's My Stick Insect and Tortoise Speed Marathon. The owner of the overall winner gets the chance to play for a holiday by answering questions, not surprisingly, on animals. It tests the imagination but in future shows cows, hamsters, snails and ferrets all get to take part.

name: A Pedra do Reino
summary: Death Caetana, the terrible ounce winged, flying over the hinterland where a circus troupe led by an old clown comes to a village. The old clown open a thick book and begins the representation of an enigmatic novel, heroic and memorialistic: The Stone of the Kingdom. The clown is Pedro Dinis Quaderna, the protagonist of the novel, already aged, and the representation of the content will be his own memories. The old clown recalls the moment, "arrested and prematurely aged by suffering , after 41 years" wrote the novel in the public chain Taperoá.

name: Wan Jian Wangzuo
summary:
In the vast Jiang Dynasty, the culture of swordsmanship has been passed down for millennia, and the people take pride in practicing it. However, reaching its pinnacle, the "Sword God Realm," is a rare feat. Over a decade ago, the once-powerful Wuji Sword God was severely injured by the schemes of the Changsheng Sword God, forcing him to retreat into seclusion in the mountains, detached from worldly affairs. 

Now, Zhan Yibai, Wuji Sword God's only disciple, has finally come of age, and the time has arrived for him to embark on a journey of training as agreed upon by master and disciple. Before departing, to enhance Zhan Yibai's self-defense abilities, Wuji Sword God gifted him his personal sword and instructed him to rapidly achieve the realm of Sword God. New to the secular world, Zhan Yibai befriends Jiang Mingyue, Princess of the dynasty, and Li Kuang, the second son of the Prince of Zhennan. Hoping to rapidly grow, he and his companions participate in the "Ancient Dynasty Ruins" trial, embarking on a remarkable journey.

name: Xiangzhe Xingchen De Changzheng
summary: Pan Gaofeng, a young rocket development engineer born in the 1980s, joined the First Academy of Aerospace Science and Technology, the cradle of his country's launch vehicles, after graduating from graduate school. He was fortunate to be a member of the development team for the Long March 5 (CZ-5), my country's most powerful launch vehicle. Working alongside his predecessors and colleagues, he overcame numerous difficulties, overcame obstacles, and defied external ridicule and skepticism. He rose from the ashes of a failed launch to ultimately achieve success, marking a crucial step in my country's transition from a major space power to a leading space power.

name: The New Chronicles of Extraordinary Beings Preface
Dear X
summary: Behind a beautiful face hides a cruel nature—Baek Ah-jin, who sees through and manipulates others' hearts. After stepping on the sacrifices of many to reach the top, everything begins to change the moment she arrives there. A woman wearing a mask to escape hell and climb to the highest place. And the story of the Xs being brutally crushed by her.

name: Ted Bundy: Dialogue With the Devil
summary: In 1984, serial killer Ted Bundy offers to help investigator Robert Keppel catch The Green River killer, a phantom who was murdering women in Seattle, Washington - right where Bundy claimed many of his victims, ten years earlier. Keppel and Bundy's cat and mouse game, played out up until Bundy was executed. Exclusive elements in the form of never-before-heard audio tapes and interviews combine to make "Ted Bundy: Dialogue with the Devil" the definitive deep dive into one of history's darkest minds - seen through the steadfast gaze of the detective who refused to look away.

name: The Traitors Ireland Uncloaked
summary:
Get ready for betrayal, banter and behind-the-scenes bombshells with The Traitors Ireland: Uncloaked, a brand-new companion show to the highly anticipated The Traitors Ireland that will air directly after the programme across RTÉ platforms later this year.

Comedian, actor, and presenter Kevin McGahern will act as our mischievoushost with Uncloaked promising to be the ultimate post-show destination for fans across Ireland. As soon as viewers have finished with their latest fix of The Traitors Ireland on RTÉ One and RTÉ Player, they'll be able to join Kevin, celebrity guests and players from the show for all the best analysis and reaction to the latest betrayals, mind games and manipulations. 

Uncloaked will take fans of The Traitors Ireland deeper into Slane Castle with dissection of the episodes and exclusive access to the banished and murdered players. This access all areas show will be available on RTÉ television, RTÉ Player and all podcast platforms.

Filmed in RTÉ Limerick, each episode will feature an exclusive interview with the banished or murdered player as well bonus unseen footage.

Kevin will have celebrity guests from the world of comedy, music, sport and entertainment, who will give their opinion on the goings on within the castle walls. Whether it's their first time tuning in or they're longtime The Traitors fans, guests will share who they're backing, who they suspect and who they'd banish without hesitation.

Don't miss a moment of the drama, watch The Traitors Ireland Uncloaked after every episode of The Traitors Ireland, later this year on RTÉ.

name: The Sun in the Dark
summary: Outcast as a demon since birth, Bai Xiaoying walks the path of immortality for one reason: revenge. A soul-bond with Ye Chenyuan, Night God, sparks an impossible love. Ye Chenyuan dies to unlock her true strength and reveal the Immortal Master pulling every string. Together with loyal friends, she kills the Immortal Master and breaks the Night God's reign. Ye Chenyuan fades into a fading sword spirit. She guards it for centuries until the day it sings his name again.

name: Go Up Against The Immortal
summary: Born into poverty, Chen Yuanqi sacrificed everything to support his beloved's education, only to be betrayed and left for dead. After awakening to divine powers from a fatal fall, he vows to defy fate and rewrite his destiny. Joined by an aloof saintess, a seductive demon queen, and a spirited spirit clansprite, he embarks on path of vengeance, crushing noble houses, obliterating demonic sects, and challenging the heavens themselves. With mortal flesh, he defies the laws of the immortal realm. As humanity teeters on the brink, he burns his very essence to shatter the chains of predestination, fighting for a chance to overturn destiny for all.

name: Çarpıntı
summary: At the heart of the series lies one secret, two mothers, and a single heart — a story of hidden truths, unexpected connections, and love that emerges from the shadows of the past.

name: Believe Me
summary: Believe Me tells the story of three victims of one of the most prolific sex attackers in British history, John Worboys, dubbed by the media as the ‘black cab rapist' after preying on women under the cover of being a ‘respectable' licensed taxi-cab driver.

name: First Lady
summary: A story that follows an unprecedented incident, in which a married man newly elected as president demands a divorce from his wife, who is to become the first lady. It unfolds during the 67 days leading up to the presidential inauguration, depicting the political intrigue and family secrets that emerge through the intense conflict between the president-elect and his wife.

name: Magnolia Table: At the Farm
summary: In Magnolia Table: At the Farm, Joanna welcomes viewers into her home to share cherished family recipes and seasonal favorites - from quick snacks to Sunday treats. Along the way, she offers helpful cooking tips, celebrates the beauty of fresh ingredients, and invites audiences to enjoy the simple pleasures of time spent in some of her favorite spaces around the farm.

name: Bitchin Rides Road To The Ridler
summary: The pinnacle of the custom car world is the Don Ridler Award, given out every year at the Detroit Autorama. Dave Kindig has always had a Ridler-sized itch he needed to scratch, and has finally found the right client and idea to make it a reality.

name: Surface
summary: Captain Noémie Chastain investigates a submerged village after the discovery of a child's skeleton. A captivating thriller miniseries, combining buried secrets, human drama, and a quest for truth.

name: Le Patriarche, le gourou des drogués
Digimon Beatbreak
summary: Tomoro Tenma lives in a world where human thoughts and emotions—known as "e-Pulse"—power AI devices called Sapotama. But when Digimon begin materializing from Sapotama and feeding on e-Pulse, society begins to fracture. After Gekkomon appears from his device, Tomoro joins Glowing Dawn, a secret team investigating rogue Digimon and the dark truth of a system both fueled and corrupted by emotion.

name: Dr. Seuss's Red Fish, Blue Fish
summary: Building a snowman under the sea? Meeting a shark and serving him tea? Red and Blue's days are full of surprises, with ocean pals of all shapes and sizes!

name: Can Bağı
summary:
Mahinur Kılıçtan, a hard-working mother, lives in a cordial, traditional neighbourhood with her daughter, Bade and her deceitful husband, Kenan. For some time now, Bade has been frequently falling ill, forcing Mahinur to leave her job as a cleaner at one of the Yılmazer Holding hospitals. Now, she bears the entire responsibility of providing for her family by taking on temporary cleaning jobs.

Aras Yılmazer, Mahinur's former employer, lives in a family mansion that has been passed down through generations, sharing the grand residence with his daughter Derin, his mother Selvihan, his aunt Leyla, and his cousin Ejder. Aras's wife, Banu, tragically passed away due to certain complications during their daughter's birth. After her death, although Aras refrained from pursuing a new relationship for some time, he eventually became engaged to Pelin—a woman from a similarly prominent family and now a management executive at the hospital—to provide Derin with a stable family life.

When fate reveals the heart-wrenching truth that Mahinur and Aras's daughters, Bade and Derin, were switched at birth, a devoted mother and a businessman find their worlds colliding in unimaginable ways. Bound by the desperate need to save the life of Bade, who was diagnosed with hemolytic anaemia, they enter into a marriage of convenience to bring a sibling into the world, who can become a stem cell donor. Yet, as they navigate the delicate threads of secrets, sacrifices, and a carefully crafted facade, an unexpected love begins to blossom—turning their unlikely union into a tale of redemption, healing, and the power of the heartstrings.

name: Lost in Kyoto
summary: A romantic story between a photographer and a model from an erotic magazine, as they shoot a film that belongs only to the two of them, right in the heart of Kyoto.

previousepisode.name: I Am Lost in Your Film

name: Insight with Haslinda Amin
summary: In a volatile and unpredictable world, the show will be the definitive guide for the global news audience to get the complete picture on the biggest story of the day. With news making executives, officials and thought-leaders from the world of business, politics and academia we will explore a story through probing interviews and nuanced conversations. The hour of programming will also highlight the most relevant stories from India which is currently one of the hottest investment destinations, but also has compelling stories that play into the Bloomberg's priority issues such as Climate change, Diversity and Technological innovation.

name: Qui peut nous battre ?
summary: For the first time, 6 experts from M6 will be brought together and participate together in a unique general knowledge game. In front of them, 100 candidates who think they are better than them on their subject of expertise: cooking, science and health, music, home, news, fashion, sport, entertainment, etc. Their goal: to beat the M6 experts. So, will a candidate be strong enough to beat the M6 experts or will the latter manage to hold their rank?

name: Salakaar
summary: When an undercover agent discovers a plan involving a nuclear weapon, a battle-hardened spymaster must revisit his clandestine history to thwart a catastrophe.

name: Broke & Sexy
summary: Three millennial young women try to make the best of their modest finances and comical misadventures while trying to live their best lives

name: The Box
summary: The Box will see a dozen celebrities placed at mercy of The Box. Each famous face enter a box and are transferred to a different location. When the box opens at the new location, the famous faces must face whatever is in front of them - with no prior warning on what or who may be on the other side of the box or the task they will have to complete.

name: Touch the Truck
summary: Dale Winton hosts Touch the Truck, an endurance game show for Channel 5. A group of 20 contestants keep their hand on a stationary Toyota Land Cruiser Amazon truck and the last one touching it wins the truck.

name: Quebranto
summary: Miranda returns to Mexico to uncover her family history and learns that her mother did not abandon her, but that she was kidnapped at birth. Finding her mother in a psychiatric hospital, suffering from the effects of abuse and violence, Miranda decides to work her way into the heart of a criminal organization to uncover the truth about what happened and make sure those responsible are punished.

name: Poly
summary: Poly is an abused pony who has become recalcitrant through bullying. He belongs to the menagerie of a traveling circus which, at the beginning of the story, is set up in Saint-Cyr-sur-Dourdan, where little Pascal lives. He is then 4 years old and comes to observe the preparations for the show he plans to attend that evening. He wanders near the caravans, opening his eyes sometimes curious, sometimes admiring, when suddenly, tragedy strikes, he sees a little defenseless pony mistreated by unscrupulous torturers. Then, an idea comes to him, to allow the pony to escape! He succeeds and helps him hide, aided by the children of the village who build him a shelter, heal him and feed him. Pascal will then live with his pony a great story of friendship full of adventure.

name: Le Jeune Fabre
summary: The sentimental education of a 16-year-old young man in Montmartre in the 1970s, his difficult beginnings in professional life, his stormy love affair with the lovely Isabelle and his quarrels with his father, a genius but alcoholic painter.

name: Cars: Lightning Racers
summary: Cars: Lightning Racers follows Lightning McQueen as he gears up for all-new adventures in Radiator Springs alongside his hilarious best friend Mater and new friends thrill-seeking drag car Pipes and mud-loving monster truck Miles.

name: Marvel's Avengers: Mightiest Friends
summary: Marvel's Avengers: Mightiest Friends introduces kid versions of Earth's Mightiest Heroes: Iron Man (Tony Stark), Captain America (Steve Rogers), Hulk (Bruce Banner), Black Panther (T'Challa), Black Widow (Natasha Romanoff) and Thor. Together, the young Avengers strive to be their best selves while facing off against classic Super Baddies.

name: Marvel's Spidey and Iron Man: Avengers Team-Up!
summary: Iron Man and the Avengers join Spidey to stop Ultron and Green Goblin from taking control of the city's devices.

previousepisode.name: Spidey and the Avengers: Halloween Team-Up!

name: Paul et Virginie
summary: The romance of two children brought together in the same universe by a shared fate. Paul is the natural son of Marguerite, the daughter of Breton peasants, abused by a gentleman and forced to hide her sin "in the colonies." Virginie is the daughter of Madame de La Tour, whom her husband, "who died of pestilential fevers," leaves a widow and soon-to-be mother on the shores of a remote island in the Indian Ocean.

name: The Valley After Show
summary: The Valley cast break down the Season 2 drama and reveal all-new details.

name: Mickey & Minnie's Holiday Songs: Halloween
summary: These new sing-along stop-motion music videos feature Mickey, Minnie and the gang as they get into the Halloween mood.

name: Mickey & Minnie's Holiday Songs: Christmas
summary: These sing-along stop-motion music videos feature Mickey, Minnie and the gang as they get into the Holiday spirit.

name: Sofia the First: Royal Magic
summary: "Sofia the First: Royal Magic" follows Sofia as she attends The Charmswell School for Royal Magic, where she discovers she is the most magical princess in the realm and must learn how to master her powers while making new royal friends.

name: Welcome Freshmen
summary: Misadventures of a group of high school students and their bumbling vice principal, who hates freshmen.

name: The Dark History of the Reincarnated Villainess
summary: Konoha Satou has a dark history. After all, she spent her teen years writing self-indulgent fantasy romance fics-like her Dark History. But since she's become its most despicable villainess, remembering every last detail is now a matter of life-and-death. Having avoided the first couple of death flags, Satou's suddenly left in the dark when a mysterious stranger returns from the Lily Kingdom-a character she doesn't recall writing in the original script. Although Yomi claims to be her ally, can Satou really trust a character she knows nothing about in such a dangerous world?

previousepisode.name: Kindness, Strength, and the Man I Must Erase

name: Dad is a hero, Mom is a spirit, I'm a reincarnator
summary: Ellen, an 8-year-old girl and half-spirit, once lived as a scientist in modern-day Japan. Now she's been reincarnated into a new family: Rovel, her father and the kingdom's legendary hero, and Origin, her mother and the queen of spirits. On top of that, Ellen herself has the power to manipulate chemical elements! But are Ellen's powers enough to protect their family's happiness?

name: Fated to Sink
summary:
Yu Yanxing's mother failed to repay the debt on time and gave her daughter to Shen Wenqian.  Shen Wenqian decides to use the girl and enters into a fictitious marriage with her, thereby avoiding the marriage with the minister's daughter.
Three years pass, and Yu Yanxing is still looking for an opportunity to escape from the golden cage.

name: He Li Hou Ta Gao Pan Bu Qi
The Rory Bremner Show
summary: Satirical comedy series starring impressionist Rory Bremner and John Bird.

name: Rory Bremner... Who Else?
summary: Comedy show featuring impressionist Rory Bremner.

name: WNBA Tip-Off
summary: WNBA Tip-Off serves as the pre-game telecast on CBS. It features a less-scripted format, highlighted by a lively round-table discussion and debate of the top story lines around the league.

name: Joc de cartes
summary: A program presented by Marc Ribas that competes in various restaurants in Catalunya. A "Joc de cartes" s'enfronten restaurants de la mateixa zone i amb el mateix tipus de cuina. Alguns serves an authentic duel between the types of cuisine and the altres, including the types of specialties. The propietaris of this restaurant are the same as the ones that value the competency. Això sí, han de tenir present que el sistema de puntuacions pot, en molts casos, capgirar el resultat final de la classificació. Your decision to determine which restaurant is the mill of the four, però, the té in Marc. Ara, torna "Joc de cartes Estiu"! En aquests cinc capítols i un special amb els moments més rellevants, el Marc busca els millors restaurants per viure l'estiu de moltes maneres different. Treiem el nostre cantó més seductor als restaurants més romàntics de Barcelona. Aside from the Costa Brava, you can visit the Millor restaurant in Platja d'Aro. In Barcelones, tastem arossos de total mena per descobrir-ne el millor. In the valley you can share the tapes of mills, you can enjoy the bones and the atmosphere of the mill on the terraces surrounded by the Maresme.  The restauradors, who participated in each other, had the opportunity to win the capitol and end up with a prize of 3,000 euros.

name: Seltzer: Den norske fattigdommen
summary: What is it like to be poor in one of the world's richest – and most equal – countries? Thomas Seltzer delves into poverty-stricken Norway.

name: A Dangerous Boy
summary: Sigurdur Thordarson, known as Siggi, becomes a hacker at 12, exposing Icelandic bank corruption at 14. Branded the "teenage whistleblower," he joins WikiLeaks in 2010, mentored by Julian Assange. Siggi leaks globally, but clashes with Assange, prompting him to spy for the FBI at 18. This tale weaves paranoia, hacking, and friendship, portraying Siggi's turbulent journey from trust to betrayal, revealing a heart-wrenching coming-of-age narrative.

name: 37 secondes
summary: On January 15, 2004, the Bugaled Breizh, a Breton trawler, sinks off the English coast, killing its 5 sailors. Marie, sister-in-law of one, links the sinking to NATO military exercises. and risks everything to uncover the truth.

name: Genius Girlfriend
summary: The genius Lin Zhixia is straightforward and reserved, never ever having a close friend. Admitted to Provincial No. 1 Middle School, she meets the sunny top student Jiang Yubai in a problem-solving competition and becomes his desk mate. As a social butterfly, Jiang helps Lin fit in, making friends like Tang Tingting, Duan Qiyan, Shen Fuxuan, and Jin Baihui. In return, Lin helps him with his studies. Starting off as competitors, they grow to support one another and become the best of friends. Together, they assist a classmate being scammed, and participate in club activities and the provincial math competition. Though he catches feelings for her, he keeps them hidden. After Lin is recommended to Fudan University, Jiang plans to confess to her during the graduation trip. Unfortunately, he has to leave because his mother is involved in a fraud case. Amid the obstacles, will the two find their way back to each other?

name: The Bus Driver: Britain's Cocaine King
summary: Bus-driver-turned-Cocaine-King. Jesus Ruiz Henao flooded '90s Britain with cocaine, building a billion-pound empire. It took police five years to convict him, in what would become the largest surveillance operation of its kind.

name: Wake Up America Early
summary: Wake up to reliable reporting that delivers the essential facts you need to start your day informed, along with expert commentary and thoughtful analysis. Get an early look at the top stories shaping national and global conversations. Whether it's politics, business, culture, or breaking news, you'll be prepared for whatever the day brings.

name: Who Do You Do
summary: Quick fire sketch show starring top impressionists of the day including Peter Goodwright, Freddie Starr and Janet Brown.

name: Johnny Vegas: Art, ADHD & Me
summary:
Comedian, actor and artist Johnny Vegas is to embark on his most personal project in an artistic love letter to his hometown. Johnny Vegas: Art, ADHD & Me will see one of Britain's best loved entertainers and trained potters take on the biggest artistic challenge of his career: to create a piece of public art for St. Helens in Merseyside. 

What starts as a creative endeavour turns into a journey of self-discovery when Johnny receives a diagnosis of ADHD. Though the original artistic vision falters, the documentary uncovers a silver lining—an honest and heartfelt conversation about mental health and understanding yourself.

name: Food Buddies
summary: Dating apps, the greatest and most evil invention of this century, can attract marriage with a finger, and can also destroy a marriage with a finger. Three unit stories, three groups of men and women, who developed a relationship called F buddies because of the dating apps.

name: Mailbag
summary: Getting free shit is so much fucking fun! The Boys open up their mailbag to see what bizarre and crazy gifts you fans have sent in!

previousepisode.name: Stick Your Hand In The Bag

name: Ta Xiu De Bu Shi Jia Xian Ma
Zhe Ge Jiang Hu Bu Yi Ban
Under the Cover
summary: To find his missing sister, police officer Han Chuan goes undercover as the legendary con artist known as "Brother Thirteen" and infiltrates a fraud-ridden island. Navigating a whirlpool of brotherhood, greed, fraud, true feelings, justice, and evil, he delves deeper and uncovers the dark truths buried within the island's shadows.

name: Joseline's Cabaret California
summary: Joseline is back with her Cabaret... this time in the Golden State.

name: Y Cyfweliad
summary: The series will see a different Welsh celebrity face the sharp spotlight of the interviewers in each episode. While they may be used to media interviews, nothing will have prepared them for the honesty and unique perspectives of Y Cyfweliad.

name: The Assembly
summary: In each episode of this unique entertainment series, one of Canada's most popular celebrities and public figures faces a group of 30 atypical neurodivergent interviewers, where no topic or question is off-limits. The Assembly is a global sensation that delivers profound revelation, authentic conversations, and a lot of laughs.

name: The Orient Express: A Golden Era of Travel
summary:
The Orient Express: A Golden Era of Travel – a 4 x 60' series set to launch on More4 in September – will take viewers on the epic 1,700-mile journey from London to Istanbul. The series will travel along the route and stop at key cities and towns including Munich, Salzburg, Vienna, Budapest and Sofia – exploring how they each played an exciting role in passengers' journeys on the Orient Express.  

In its golden era, the train was a second home for celebrities, politicians, monarchs and spies – as well as a notable inspiration for author, Agatha Christie – and the series will explore the history of the route and chart how Europe has changed since the Orient Express launched in 1883. As well as the glory days of the past, the series examines how war and political upheaval shaped and impacted the cross-country train service that connected countries across the continent for decades.  

Comparing then and now, The Orient Express: A Golden Era of Travel will also feature the inaugural run of Golden Eagle's luxury train service from Paris to Istanbul – highlighting how the lavish rail travel pioneered by the Orient Express in the 19th and 20th centuries continues to this day.

name: Final Draft
summary: Twenty-five athletes, most retired, compete to win 30M yen to launch their second career. Can they overcome tough physical and psychological challenges?

previousepisode.name: The End for Those Not Chosen

name: The Big Pound Shop Swap
summary: Could you live off bargain store products alone? Denise Van Outen leads this bold consumer experiment, as proudly picky families swap their supermarket go-tos for discount store alternatives.

name: The Princess Diaries
summary: The daughter of reality royalty turns 18! Follow Princess as she celebrates her milestone birthday & carves her own path – away from her famous folks, Katie Price & Peter Andre.

name: Confessions of a Steroid Gang
summary: The dark side of self-improvement. With testimony from users, gang members and those who caught them, this is how a father and son from north Wales built an illegal steroid empire.

name: The Last Irish Missionaries
summary: Bryan Dobson and Dearbhail McDonald chart the unique evolution of the Irish missionary movement.

name: Titanic: Secrets of the Shipwreck
summary: For seven decades after its tragic sinking, the Titanic lay undiscovered on the ocean floor. This compelling series tracks the search for the wreck across the depths of the Atlantic.

name: Lovers
summary: Kang Jae is a wealthy businessman and gangster and Mi Joo is a plastic surgeon. These two meet after Mi Joo mistakes Kang Jae as being her sleazy brother-in-law. Kang Jae just happens to be the boyfriend of Mi Joo's pregnant neighbour, Yoo Jin. Sae Yeon meets Mi Joo and falls in love with her feisty attitude. Kang Jae works for the father of Sae Yeon who is a gangster. Mi Joo and Kang Jae fall in love.

name: Irreplaceable
summary: After a devastating upheaval in her family, small-town girl Xu Chi enters the consulting industry, determined to live by one principle: never let herself be replaced. There, she crosses paths with elite partner Ye Xinzhi, who was once framed and has been plotting his revenge ever since. Starting as a mentor and mentee, the two gradually move from mutual attraction and testing to well-matched allies. Ultimately, they discover that they are irreplaceable to each other.

name: Piaomiao Jian Xian Chuan
summary:
Dongfang Shaohong, possessing two Dao bodies, but lacking the spiritual roots to awaken his spirit body, is ridiculed by his own clan and even betrayed by his fiancée. Troubles pile up one after another. Dongfang Shaohong's father, imprisoned for possessing the secret to entering the Cangyu Immortal Palace, is trapped by the Immortal Alliance.

In the midst of his clan's crisis, Dongfang Shaohong inadvertently uses his own blood to activate the Dao Stone of Immortal Source within him, repelling the Immortal Alliance and saving the clan from the brink.

In these dire straits, Dongfang Shaohong is fortunately rescued by his father's friend, Master Ji Yin, and is offered refuge within the Piaomiao Sect. Within the Taiyin Mountain ravine of the Piaomiao Sect, Dongfang Shaohong diligently cultivates, but possessing the Dark Night Dao Body of the Nether Clan is viewed as an anomaly among the human race and constantly harassed by his fellow disciples. Dongfang Shaohong realizes that only by becoming powerful enough can he rescue his father, clear his name, and expose the Immortal Alliance's conspiracy.

name: Alice and Steve
summary:
Alice is devastated when her best friend Steve starts dating her 26-year-old daughter Izzy. She's going to lose her best friend and her daughter in one fell swoop. Alice tries everything she can to end the relationship. Unfortunately for her, Steve's more than ready for the attack, and what begins as a perfect friendship, devolves into an all-out feud.

A hilarious, messy, and complicated exploration of friendship, family, and love, Alice and Steve is an anti-romantic comedy that asks the question, how far would you go for love - or revenge? Will Alice forgive Steve? Will Steve and Izzy make a relationship work? Amongst all the questions hanging in the balance, one thing is certain; their lives will never be the same again.

name: Fu Ren Ta Zhuan Zhi Bu Fu
Xi Tong Bi Wo Tie Tie Bing Jiao Fu Jun
Autumn Scenery
summary: Fifteen years after the mysterious death of housekeeper Chen Ruyi, Yue Yan—the girl Chen once saved—secretly infiltrates the powerful Gu family to exact revenge. As she gathers evidence, she uncovers a dark international organ trafficking conspiracy and discovers that the seemingly reckless Gu family second young master hides a secretive identity of his own.

name: Fall in You
summary: Qiao Yan's life is turned upside down when her parents are suddenly killed in a car accident. Overnight, she goes from being their beloved little princess to a lonely orphan. Soon after, Gu Changfeng, the chairman of the Gu Corporation and a man claiming to be her biological grandfather, appears and insists on bringing her back to China. Though reluctant to return to the Gu family, Qiao Yan is troubled by the many suspicious details surrounding her parents' deaths. Determined to uncover the truth, she agrees to go back and begins to approach her so-called "uncle," Gu Jingyuan, the adopted son of the Gu patriarch. At the Gu household, she plays the part of a meek and pitiful orphan, trying to win over Gu Jingyuan. But he remains cold and indifferent, unmoved by her act. A hidden battle begins between the two, each equally matched in wit and will. Just as Qiao Yan becomes convinced that Gu Jingyuan is the one behind her parents' murder, he risks his life to save her from a raging fire, and confesses his desire to protect both her and the Gu family. Shaken, Qiao Yan begins to understand his pain, and in that understanding, falls deeply in love with him. Their forbidden love weathers countless trials. But just as they finally decide to defy Gu patriarch's opposition and walk into marriage with open hearts, a far greater conspiracy crashes down upon them. To protect each other, they are forced to hide their true feelings, caught in a storm of searing love and bitter suffering. Amidst the chaos, they use their own flesh and blood to shield each other from the oncoming storm.

name: Cambalacho
summary: The series follows the lives of Naná and Gegê, a pair of con artists. Gegê is Tina Pepper's uncle, a Tina Turner fan who dreams of becoming a famous singer.

name: Bambolê
summary: A non-traditional widower for the 1950s, Álvaro has an open relationship with his daughters and becomes the target of criticism from his sister-in-law Fausta, especially when he meets Marta.

name: Bu Yuan Liang, Bu Fu Hun! Ta Ling Pan Gao Zhi
Riacho Doce
summary: In a fishing village, Grandma Manuela, endowed with mystical powers, seals the body of her grandson, Nô, from love. But Eduarda's arrival completely changes the boy's destiny.

name: The Terrors of Jordan Mendoza
summary: The Terrors of Jordan Mendoza follows a very scared man as he navigates a barrage of absurd, terrifying, and hilarious dreamscapes.

name: George Clarke's Kitchen vs Garden
summary: Hand trowels or tea towels? Countertops or treetops? Architect George Clarke and garden designer Luke Millard help families choose between their kitchen and garden renovations..

name: Soldier: For King and Country
summary:
They're an elite fighting unit like no other - steeped in tradition, primed for battle, and ready to die for King and Country. If Britain goes to war in Eastern Europe, the brave men and women of The Royal Welsh will be on the frontline, laying down their lives to protect our cherished freedoms.

This series offers unprecedented access to the Royal Welsh, one of Britain's most decorated armoured infantry units, as they live together and train in their Warrior armoured vehicles, ready to be called up at a moment's notice to join a war in eastern Europe and beyond. When the going gets tough, these Welsh Warriors are the guys you call.

For six months, our cameras follow the 1st Battalion Royal Welsh as they live, work and train, preparing for a war that looks likelier every day. We follow every trial, every tradition, and every triumph, and witness the pride and the honour of serving in this incredible Welsh regiment.

name: Mostra a Mala
summary: Of course we wouldn't let you miss her. The little princess of Brazil, Chanel, came back home with all her luggage unpacked and wishing for gossip! Hosting the eliminated queens of Drag Race Brasil season 2, the contestants will show everything they presented on the runway and a sneak peek of what they didn't have the chance to display.

name: Lost in the Desert with Nick Knowles
summary:
Nick Knowles returns to 5 for a truly spectacular adventure, this time in the most desolate place on earth - the Gobi Desert.

At five times the size of the UK, with the smallest population on earth, Mongolia is vast and remote and the stunning wilderness of the Gobi covers a third of the country.

As Nick discovers, the land of Genghis Kahn and dinosaurs is not only steeped in rich traditions but is also home to some of the most warm-hearted people in the world.

From a horse academy keeping alive the remarkable horseback archery skills of the Kahn's warrior hoard to a bout of Mongolian wrestling, followed by a visit to a shaman, this adventure both moved and fascinated Nick beyond expectation.

name: Taste of Russia
summary: Taste of Russia is unique. It's not a cooking show; it's not a travel show: it's both! Over 190 nationalities live Russia, each with their own unique cultures and food traditions. Join two friends, Russian actor Oscar Kuchera and American foodie Glen Kutsovsky, as they explore the world's biggest country through the vast diversity of its cuisine. Along the way, they learn to prepare traditional Russian dishes while delving into their history.

name: News Team
summary: In 2013, RT became the first news channel to receive more than 1 billion views on YouTube, confirming its status as the world's biggest news content provider. ‘News Team' shows how the channel's news mechanism operates through the lens of its correspondents' work.

name: Gag Tag
summary: Two teams of comics are tested on their - knowledge of comedy trivia - as well as getting plenty of opportunities to out-gag each other.

name: Comet-san
summary: Far away in the deep reaches of space lies the Beta Star on where magical human-like people live. Comet is one of those people who is a student in a school in the Beta Star. But one day, she made an accident in the school, causing the principal to get angry at her and banish her to Earth in hopes it can teach her to be responsible for her actions. In Earth, she made her residence with both the Kawagoe and Ishihara families as she uses her magic to solve some problems with a little guidance.

name: Comet-san
summary: Comet, a soon-to-be graduate of the Star School on Planet Virgo, arrives on Earth via UFO with the task of finding the most beautiful thing on the planet as a graduation exam. She is taken in by the Sawano family, working as a housekeeper and gets into various high jinks with the use of her Magic Baton. Receiving guidance and encouragement from her Star Mother above, Comet finds the true beauty on Earth within her various experiences of love through human contact.

name: I am Hacked
summary: We seem to spend most of our lives online. We work, shop, learn, talk to friends, upload, download, share and like all day long! Almost everything we do is online. It's often convenient and can even be fun, but all that digital technology comes at a price. You might be surprised to know how easily you could be hacked. Learn how to stay safe online and avoid falling victim to cybercrime with RT Documentary's latest series. Do you know the rules of digital hygiene? Find out about the many types of cybercrime and the latest developments in the digital world: ‘I am Hacked'.

name: The Blame
summary: The series begins when the body of teenage figure skater Sophie Madsen is discovered, sending shockwaves through the town of Wakestead. As DI Crane and DI Radley dig deeper, what starts as a tragic death, spirals into a tangled web of lies, institutional cover-ups, and moral compromise. As the clock ticks and trust fractures, Crane must navigate both a murder investigation and the treacherous politics inside her own team.

name: A Viagem
summary: Alexandre attempts to rob the safe at his office to pay off a debt and is arrested. In prison, he decides to take his own life and begins to torment all those he holds responsible for his fate.

name: Estrellita mía
summary: Estrellita is a young, poor peasant girl. Her mother is very ill, so she goes to Buenos Aires. Before she dies, Estrellita's mother makes the girl's father promise that he will take care of her when she is left alone in the world. Estrellita's mother dies, and the man, manipulated by his sophisticated wife, takes her to work in his mansion as a servant. There, Estrellita meets Juano, a sad man married to a woman he doesn't love, and who is only with her because he feels guilty about her disability. Estrellita and Juanjo fall in love, and she becomes pregnant. Many will try to separate them, but their love is greater than all.

name: Самые сильные
summary: American actor and showman Glen Kutsovsky travels around Russia in search of adventure and thrills. He meets the strongest people, interviews them and tries to uncover the secrets of their superpowers.

name: Ratu Ratu Queens: The Series
summary: Leaving behind their homes in Indonesia, four women form an unlikely friendship and face eccentric dilemmas as they navigate life in New York.

previousepisode.name: Enough With The Planet Of The Taz

name: Not Like Mama
summary: Home chefs attempt to recreate their mother's famous recipe to see if their version stacks up against mama's original dish.

previousepisode.name: Ghormeh Sabzi with the Mehditach Family

name: The Floor
summary: In The Floor, 81 quiz fanatics face off in quiz duels on a giant LED floor divided into 81 equal squares, each representing its own field of knowledge. The goal is to conquer the entire floor and take home a huge cash prize. The rules are simple. A random contestant challenges an adjoining opponent in a quiz duel. They play against each other in the category of the opponent's square. Categories range from 'famous athletes' to 'Hollywood actors' and from ‘iconic buildings' to 'mammals'. Some questions are visually supported by photographs, others by sound, while other duels focus on open questions, multiple choice, association: the possibilities are endless. The winner of a duel conquers his opponent's square, gaining more ground - the loser leaves the game. The further the game progresses, the more exciting the duels become and the higher the stakes. After ten episodes, who will be the last person standing on The Floor and take home the impressive cash prize?

name: Human Specimens
summary: Human Specimens is adapted from the novel by Kanae Minato, one of Japan's most celebrated mystery writers, known for her international bestseller Confessions which was adapted into the acclaimed film that represented Japan at the 83rd Academy Awards. The dark tale follows Professor Shirô Sakaki, a butterfly researcher, who confesses to turning six young boys, including his own son Itaru, into "human specimens."

name: Gözleri Karadeniz
summary: Azil, raised in the rebellious waters of the Black Sea, is suddenly confronted with all the secrets of his past: he is the lost heir of the Maçari family, one of Turkey's most powerful dynasties. Shaken by the death of the woman he knew as his mother, Azil steps into the dark world of Istanbul in search of the truth. Fate drags him into both a reckoning with his brother and an impossible love that burns his heart. In this world of intrigues and betrayals, Azil's test will be not only with power but also with conscience.

name: Jing Ji Yu Jiu Yue Guang
Dang Mei Li Xiao Shi Hou
Chong Hui Jiu Ling Nian Dai，Chong Qi Wu Du Man Di Jin
Mischievous Kiss: YouTube Edition
summary: Seven short episodes dealing with Ha Ni's and Seung Jo's life after their marriage, released on the official youtube channel ytkiss.

name: Rescue the Girl
summary: Ex-cop's life shatters when kidnappers take his daughter, implant a bomb, and force him on lethal missions. With enigmatic allies, his choices rewrite destinies while unraveling a conspiratorial web.

name: Keeping up with Beauty
summary: Bound by a promise that spans a thousand years, a valiant female general is transported into the body of Fu Yunyun, a dying heiress. To clear her name and uncover the truth, she uses herself as bait, navigating the cold and calculating husband with careful diplomacy. At the same time, she faces the devoted yet scheming attention of her cunning brother-in-law and the unwavering loyalty of a soldier who followed her through time. Three men vie for Fu Yunyun's heart, each showing their own cunning, while the confident and strong-willed heroine stays true to herself, cutting through layers of deception to finally uncover the truth and her ultimate desire in life.

name: The Triple Echo of Time
summary: The enigmatic transfer student Xun Weilai and the strange new neighbor Zhao Liao disrupt the mundane life of high school student Zhao Zuoyou. Little does he know, these two individuals are actually his future selves! At ages 16, 41, and 66, the three versions of Zhao Zuoyou possess completely different personalities and intentions. Each has their own purpose, and they begin to vie for the singular life they share.

name: Big Mistakes
summary: Big Mistakes follows Nicky and Morgan, two deeply incapable siblings who are in over their heads when a misguided theft for their dying grandmother accidentally pulls them into the world of organized crime. Blackmailed into increasingly dangerous assignments, they clumsily fail upwards, sinking deeper into chaos they're ill-equipped to handle.

name: Ставка на любовь
summary: «Stavka na lyubov'» is an extreme reality show where star couples test the strength of their feelings. According to the rules of the project, participants undergo tests and place "bets" on their partners: will they cope or not. Those who guess the outcome of the tests receive immunity, and those who do not guess are nominated by voting. Only one couple will win and receive a cash prize.

name: Выживалити. Змееловы
summary:
The project continues the tradition of the "Survivality" universe: the heroes who find themselves in it are tested not only on a wide variety of physical and moral qualities, but also on their intellect, resourcefulness, and cunning.
Two teams of celebrities find themselves in an exotic country. Each team includes a lone wolf whose task is to prevent their teammates from winning the challenges and remain undetected until the very end of the episode.
Abandoned to their fate in the wild jungle, the heroes survive in a camp they've built themselves and undergo challenges prepared by the host, pitting the teams against each other to discover who the "Snake" is on their team.

name: O Assassinato do Ator Rafael Miguel
summary: This gripping docuseries traces the events leading up to the 2019 murder of young Brazilian actor Rafael Miguel and his parents.

name: Piensa Rápido
summary:
Renowned actor and comedian, Adrián Uribe, returns as the iconic public transit driver, "El Vítor," to host this entertaining game show. On "Piensa Rápido," two teams of friends and family compete to see who can guess the most popular answers to general knowledge and pop culture questions the fastest. The key to winning is using quick thinking and wit to figure out what everyone else is thinking before time runs out. In the question rounds, "El Vítor" will give an incomplete phrase, and teams will take turns trying to find the most popular words that complete it. They will have 60 seconds to do so and will get the first letter of each word on the screen as a clue.

Each episode consists of three question rounds, following a consistent format to ensure a smooth and exciting flow. At the end of these rounds, the team with the lowest score will be eliminated.

The winning team will advance to the final round, where they will have a limited amount of time to correctly identify the main words that complete four phrases. For each correctly completed phrase, they will earn cash prizes and have the chance to win up to $6,000.

name: A Viagem
summary: Diná is the sister of the delinquent and vengeful Alexandre, who, after dying in prison, begins to torment from the spiritual plane those he considers to be his enemies.

name: Leonard and Hungry Paul
summary: The story follows two unique board-gaming friends meandering through leafy suburban life, charting a story about Judo, ancient Rome, first loves, and the expansion of the Universe.
